In the United States, this document is subject to Freedom of Information Act (FOIA) Exemption 4 and may not be reproduced or otherwise disseminated without the written approval of Eli Lilly and Company or its subsidiaries.
Miri induction IV dosing at Weeks 0, 4, and 8; miri maintenance SC dosing from Week 12.
For details about TZP dose escalation, see Section 6.1.4.2.
Visits 2 through 15 will be conducted Q4W. During the Maintenance Period, some of the visits will be remote; for details, see the SoA (Section 1.3).
Visit 801 will occur 4 weeks after the last treatment visit or ED.
For definition of the primary endpoints, see Section 3.

The SoA described below should be followed for all participants enrolled in Study AMCD. However, for those participants whose participation in this study is affected by exceptional circumstances, such as pandemics or natural disasters, please refer to Section 10.16 for additional guidance. If clinically warranted, an unscheduled visit may occur per investigator discretion.
Telehealth visits may be by telephone or other technology. Gray-shaded columns in the SoA tables represent telehealth visits.
Procedures for screening (Visit 1) may be conducted over more than 1 day as long as all activities are completed within the allowable visit tolerance.

data.description: Protocol Amendment (e) electronically signed and approved by Lilly on 04 Nov 2025 GMT. Substantial amendment incorporating regulatory feedback including replacement of 'mucosal healing' with 'histologic-endoscopic mucosal improvement plus absence of neutrophils', updates to Schedule of Activities, addition of gallbladder disease risk assessment, new exclusion criterion for abnormal ECG, updates to mMS appendix per FDA Guidance 2016, and other clarifications.
